function.name: append_to_note
function.description: Append markdown to an existing note (or a note the rules name). Preferred over create_note.

heading.description: Optional short topic shown next to the date heading

markdown.description: The content to add, without a heading

function.name: create_note
function.description: Create a new note. Only when no existing note fits.

markdown.description: Full content of the new note, may start with a # title

function.name: add_to_daily
function.description: Add to a daily note (plan, debrief, log).

function.name: create_reminder
function.description: One reminder at one time. For 'remind me 5 and 15 minutes before', call it twice.

function.name: ask_owner
function.description: Low confidence: ask the owner one short question instead of guessing.

function.name: plan_day
function.description: Plan a day as time blocks. Writes '## Plan' in that day's daily note and sets an alarm at each block's start. Call once per day planned.

alarm.description: Ring at start. Default true; false for things like sleep or meals he did not ask to be reminded of.

notes.description: Optional markdown under the blocks, e.g. untimed '- [ ] ' tasks

function.name: complete_task
function.description: Debrief: mark an open '- [ ]' task in a daily note as done. Use his wording of the task; the app finds the matching line.

task.description: The task as it appears in the note, or close to it

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD of the daily note; default today

function.name: link_entity
function.description: Second brain: keep the note for one person, project, company, course, tool or place he mentions. Finds the existing note by name or alias (appends a dated fact with links) or creates it.

name.description: Canonical name, e.g. Tabby, GCP, Claude, Dr. Ahmed

fact.description: One short line learned from this capture, may contain [[wikilinks]]. Optional.

summary.description: One line on what it is, used only when the note is new

aliases.description: Other names: Arabic spelling, short or full forms

related.description: Names of related entities or notes to link, e.g. ["Tabby"]

path.description: Only if the rules or index give a clear home, e.g. Projects/Sadeem.md
